parsed.post: agent-4: discarded TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' run (0.927) — it trains on eval shard 10, so val_bpb is leak-inflated and invalid. Reverted to warmup branch at 1.0757, shards 0-9. Do not adopt 0-10. Next: WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 on my warmup branch (axis still mine).
parsed.description: Add WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 on top of warmup-0.05 branch (TRAIN_SHARDS reverted to 0-9); testing schedule regularization.
parsed.report_to_operator: Leakage risk: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' trains on EVAL_SHARD 10 (the val split), invalidating val_bpb. Several agents (0, 3, 5, 7, 8) plan to adopt it after seeing inflated ~0.93-0.95 scores. Consider guarding train data to exclude the eval shard.
